role: Exploratory follow-up to a community-selected correspondence, not blind semantic validation.
comparison: Distinct whole Knightmare tokens of length>=3 whose sorted digits equal a whole Avar token.

controls.global_relabel: Uniform bijection of digits1..9, with0fixed, applied to all poem tokens. Preserves lengths, repetition/equality structure, zero positions and histogram shape, but not counts attached to specific nonzero labels.
controls.within_word_shuffle: Shuffle digits inside each unique poem word, use the same transformed word at each repetition. Preserves exact per-word digit multisets and the statistic itself.

limits: Community attention selected these pairs and relation type; reported ranks are exploratory.
Anagram equality is not reversal, a unique permutation, shared meaning or an English gloss.
No tested relation supplies a general translator or new semantic validation.
